mentions.name: Data Governance in a Box
mentions.description: A "Data Governance in a Box" solution aimed at small businesses that run on outdated routers and weak security practices, providing bundled data governance and security. It is starting in Canada and is open to collaboration.
mentions.problem: Small businesses are using out-of-date routers and security practices.
mentions.audience: Small businesses using outdated routers and security practices
